supersedes_note: 0.1.0 was never used for coding, unitizing or any derived event; schemas/codebook/v0.1.0.json is kept unchanged as a record

semver_policy.patch: wording, examples, clarifications; no coded value can change
semver_policy.minor: new enum value, field, module or core field; existing codes stay valid
semver_policy.major: enum value removed, renamed or redefined; or a derived-field threshold/window changes
semver_policy.before_1_0_0: 1.0.0 is reserved for the pilot freeze (CB §13), so before it a change that would otherwise be major bumps the minor version; it still needs a changelog entry and a dated pilot pre-registration amendment stating what data had been seen (same policy as outcome-thresholds, ADR-035)

burst_series.detection_and_segmentation: raw star-history daily net counts (TM-33; ADR-032.3, ADR-035), on endpoint days in star_history_day_tz (OM §1.2), for every case
burst_series.onset_refinement: hourly watch-list stargazerCount snapshots (GraphQL, TM-02; ADR-032.1) only where they cover the 48-hour detection window; never used for detection, end, merging or quiet
burst_series.filtered_variants: not used to define burst or quiet units (unknown for most windows, ADR-032.3); where a filtered variant is class-eligible for the whole case window a re-segmentation may be reported as exploratory

event_parameters.burst_detection_rule: velocity-v0 on endpoint days (OM §2.1; thresholds JSON burst_detection): day d fires when n(d-1) + n(d) >= 100 and z >= 3, baseline = the 30 endpoint days before d-1 converted to 48-hour sums, sigma with the sqrt(mean) floor of ADR-027 item 3; a burst starts at the first firing day not already inside a burst
event_parameters.burst_onset_rule: OM §2.1 exactly: where hourly snapshots cover the 48-hour window (endpoint days d-1 and d), onset = earliest hour with net gain > mu_h + 3*sqrt(mu_h) (mu_h + 1 if mu_h == 0), with mu_h = mu_d / 24 (mu_d = mean stars per endpoint day over the 30-day detection baseline), else window start, precision hour; otherwise the same rule on endpoint days d-1, d with mu_d, onset = start of the first qualifying endpoint day, else start of d-1, precision day. The burst containing the case's recorded T_burst onset takes that recorded onset and precision.
event_parameters.burst_end_rule: start of first run of 3 consecutive endpoint days (OM §1.2) each with raw star-history stars <= mu_d + 3*sqrt(mu_d) (mu_d + 1 if mu_d == 0), mu_d = mean stars per endpoint day over the burst's detection baseline
event_parameters.burst_shape_rule: sudden_fast_decay: peak <= 48h after onset and < 50% of peak within 7d; gradual_build: peak > 7d after onset; else mixed (on endpoint days: peak day index 0 or 1 from the onset day; a daily count < 50% of the peak within day indices <= 7; gradual_build when the peak day index > 7)

inputs_frozen_at_T: README at the last commit before T
the evidence record that fixed T_launch, if anchor_type is launch
novelty_claim.present_requires: first-party quoted span (<= 300 chars) with an explicit novelty marker, from the inputs
novelty_claim.absent_requires: every listed input captured and none contains a qualifying span
not_novelty: release or version newness (relaunch language, CB §3.6)
performance or cost superlatives without a novelty claim (benchmark_claim)
generic marketing adjectives (modern, next-generation, powerful, simple)

spread_graph.account_nodes_hold: ADR-022 until LQ-8 answered; lifting requires an ADR plus CB-10 and CB-14

also_requires: both endpoint evidence hash-valid and locators verified
source timestamp precedes target timestamp given precision
no privacy hold on either endpoint

spread_graph.replied_edge_rule: only when replier is the project node or the reply links the repo/site; otherwise reply_count on the item
spread_graph.reach_storage: band only; exact count discarded at ingest (CB-10)

public_figure_rule.status_natural_persons: inactive until LQ-7 answered and ADR
public_figure_rule.organisations_and_publications: may be named in private UI only (LQ-7 default)
criteria_all_required: coded activity within that public role (FADP Art. 31(2)(f))
role documented in a cleared-source snapshot
not a matched-loser maintainer nor personal-account repo owner in the panel

day_precision_onset.t0: start of the onset endpoint day (OM §2.1)
day_precision_onset.proximal_window: [t0 - 48h, end of the onset endpoint day + 6h]
day_precision_onset.time_offset_h: measured from t0; time_precision of the onset recorded on every candidate

distal_window.requires: quoted lag rationale or explicit citation by a proximal item

trigger_attribution.high_confidence_requires: hour-precision onset and hour-precision candidate timestamp
trigger_attribution.interpretation: association only; causal claims only via R8.1 event studies

confidence_rules.low: every candidate; or promoted with an unresolved sensitivity flag
confidence_rules.medium: promoted per PRD §9.3 but not all high conditions
confidence_rules.high: promoted AND >=10 supporting winner cases from >=3 strata AND both §9.3 routes (prevalence contrast and event-study 90% CI excludes 0) AND alpha >= 0.80 with CI lower bound >= 0.70 on every promotion-deciding field used AND no sensitivity flag AND every contradicting case explained from coded evidence

all_required: higher prevalence among winners than among their matched losers, OR an event-study effect whose 90% CI excludes zero
contradicting cases are listed and explained
preconditions stated in a testable form
codebook_additions_never_relaxing: fields failing their alpha gate cannot feed promotion
prevalence excludes unknown; unknown-share gap > 20 pp between sides is flagged
demotion to candidate recorded in history

activation_any: primary or secondary category in [ai-apps-agents, ml-infra]
description/topics/README hero at T names an ML model, LLM or agent framework as the product core

shared_case_fields.novelty_claim: same value as the case-level novelty_claim (case_fields, CB §5.1); coded once per case, not again by the module

activation_any: paid or hosted offering by the same project with evidence <= T+90d
README at T mainly Chinese or has a Chinese README variant
V2EX mention in the case window
chinese_ecosystem.coverage_note: V2EX only, off by default until H2 Q8 (ADR-010); Juejin, Zhihu, Bilibili are GAP; Gitee not audited; default channel-attribution result is 'insufficient evidence'

activation_any: repo at T ships a command-line entry point
owner is a GitHub organisation identified as company or foundation by a first-party artifact
README at T states maintenance or sponsorship by an organisation
timeline has a relaunch or pivot event
repo age at T > 365 days with evidence of a prior launch

reliability_gate.ordinal_unknown_handling: unknown treated as missing; companion nominal alpha on known/unknown must also pass
reliability_gate.multi_valued_handling: split into one binary nominal field per value
reliability_gate.min_pairable_units: set in M4-T2 pre-registration; not assessed = fail

coding_rules.on_citation_failure: drop value; set unknown with reason citation_failed
coding_rules.outcome_masking: outcome classes hidden from coders except for mechanism_support.direction, coded in a later pass after presence is locked

privacy_rules_cb_11.P1: no GDPR Art. 9 / FADP Art. 5(c) attributes; no gender, age, nationality or location of individuals
privacy_rules_cb_11.P2: no scoring or ranking of natural persons; reach in bands only
privacy_rules_cb_11.P5: public-figure rule inactive for natural persons until LQ-7 + ADR
privacy_rules_cb_11.P6: no private individual, matched loser or personal-account repo named in any output
privacy_rules_cb_11.P7: coded values from person-level evidence inherit person_level_24m
privacy_rules_cb_11.P8: no coded values, spans, snapshots or pseudonyms in git

g1_category_change_denominator_note: unchanged from 0.1.0 (79 values); case_fields enums (novelty_claim, novelty_kind) are not in the denominator, like other non-core enums. (b) new case-level non-core fields novelty_claim and novelty_kind (MC-09); ai_hype.novelty_claim now shares the case value. No enum value in g1_category_change_denominator added, removed or renamed. Minor bump: (b) adds fields; (a) changes a derived-field input, which before 1.0.0 bumps minor (semver_policy.before_1_0_0).
